versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# Events policies

- Contracts and amendments up to $10,000: the Director of Events signs. Over $10,000: the Executive Director.
  Staff may negotiate but not sign.
- Attendee data: registrants choose at registration whether to share their contact details with exhibitors
  (field share_with_exhibitors). Exhibitors and sponsors receive only opted-in contacts, name, company, title
  and email. Never phone numbers or the full list.
- Accessibility: we provide reasonable accommodations requested at registration or later (captioning, ASL,
  mobility, dietary). Ask the attendee what works; confirm in writing.
- PDH certificates: 1 PDH per 60 minutes of instruction, for sessions the attendee is recorded as attending
  (badge scan). Breaks, meals and exhibits earn none.

documents.title: Henley Hotel Detroit group sales agreement (excerpt)

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# Group sales agreement, GLSFE Fall Technical Conference, Nov 4-6, 2026 (signed 2025-12-02)

Room block: 110 rooms on Wed 11/4 and 110 on Thu 11/5 (220 room-nights) at $189 + tax. Cutoff: Monday 11/2,
17:00 ET; unreserved rooms release to general inventory.
Attrition: the group will pick up at least 80% of the block (176 room-nights), measured cumulatively after
cutoff. Shortfall is billed at the group rate per room-night, less any shortfall rooms the hotel resells.
Food and beverage: final guarantees due by 12:00 noon ET three business days before each function (Monday 11/2
for Thursday's functions). The guarantee may not be lower than 90% of the contracted count. The group is billed
for the guarantee or the actual number served, whichever is greater. The hotel sets 3% over the guarantee.
Contracted counts: breakfast 400, lunch 400, reception 350.
Charges: 24% service charge on food and beverage; 6% Michigan sales tax on food, beverage and service charge.

documents.title: How we set guarantees (Events team method)

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
1. Use registrations as of Monday 08:00. 2. Apply our show rates from the last three Fall conferences:
breakfast 78%, lunch 92%, reception 64%. 3. Round up. 4. Apply the contract floor (90% of contracted count,
rounded up). 5. The guarantee is the higher of steps 3 and 4. 6. Note the hotel's 3% overset. 7. Send Simone
the counts with dietary needs before noon.
